title: Performance Modelling: Matmuls, Roofline and Sharding
summary: Estimate wall-clock time for bf16 matmuls of several shapes on one accelerator with a roofline model, extend it to a 72-layer stack of alternating matmuls and check whether it fits in one device's memory, compare pipeline and tensor parallelism across two devices on a single input, and build a cost model for sharding a feed-forward network by tensor or by token across p devices.
